status.summary: Top welterweight contender, pro record 17-2 (UFC 10-2). Lost a unanimous decision to champion Islam Makhachev at UFC 330 (Aug 15, 2026; 46-49, 46-49, 47-48) after being knocked down by a head kick in round 2. Before that he beat Belal Muhammad (UD, Nov 22, 2025) and Carlos Prates (UD, Apr 26, 2025). A bout with Yaroslav Amosov at UFC 335 (Dec 12, 2026, Las Vegas) has been widely reported but not confirmed by the UFC in the sources found.
status.ranking: #1 welterweight contender per CBS Sports; #2 per EventClock (both Nov 2026; not checked against ufc.com)
status.next_fight: Reported, not officially confirmed: vs Yaroslav Amosov, UFC 335, Dec 12, 2026, T-Mobile Arena, Las Vegas

knocked down by a Makhachev head kick in round 2 of UFC 330

modest power: 3 KO/TKO wins in 12 UFC fights and no finish since 2023
style.summary: A tall, rangy orthodox kickboxer who fights almost entirely at distance (90% of significant strikes landed at range). He builds rounds with the jab, low kicks and body work. He beats strikers and strong wrestlers alike on volume and defense, but the two best grapplers he has faced (Rakhmonov, Makhachev) won decisions by holding him down for long spells.

moves.notes: Weights follow his target split in fighters.json. Decayed significant attempts go 69.5% head, 14.9% body, 15.6% legs; landed strikes go 52.8% head, 21.3% body, 26.0% legs, the highest leg and body shares in this group and well above the welterweight league (9.3% legs, 13.9% body of attempts). Leg and body kicks therefore get heavy weight. Legs went 43/43 vs Magny and 27/28 vs Muhammad. The split between calf and inside kicks is not in the data and is set roughly even. 90% of his landed strikes come at distance, so knees and elbows are near zero. The jab gets the top weight, a judgment from his distance-first output and 74 in reach. No spinning finishes are recorded. Sources: ufcstats sums and per-fight totals.

appearance.build: tall and lean for welterweight; 6 ft 3 in with a 74 in reach (ufcstats)
appearance.hair: short light-brown to blond hair, usually styled up

engine_notes.note: In 5-round fights his significant output relative to round 1 runs 1.00, 2.78, 2.72, 2.28, 2.17 (three fights: Rakhmonov, Prates, Makhachev). That means a slow first round, then steady volume to the end.
Opponents control him 250 s per 15 min decayed, against a welterweight league rate of 167. Decayed takedown defense is 69% (league 64%), but the stuffs give way against elite chain wrestlers.
Chin: no KO losses. 2 knockdowns absorbed career (Song Kenan 2023, Makhachev 2026); decayed rate 1.03 KD per 100 significant head strikes absorbed (league 0.84).
He out-landed both of his conquerors in significant strikes: 42-37 vs Rakhmonov and 29-22 vs Makhachev. Judges scored the control time over the striking margin.
